Spousey Points

Favors, fairly counted — with a little ♥ and a lot of cha-ching.

Test page logins: Jonathan or Elizabeth — any password works.

Send an invite

Invite someone to trade points, tokens, and favors with you.

Acting as
One phone plays both sides on this test page — switch to act as the other person.

Your downtime — what your points are worth

Your 100 weekly points stand for 100% of your free time. Set how much downtime you actually get in a week and the estimator prices every favor as a slice of it. It's an average — it doesn't have to be exact.

Default for testing: 10 hrs — 2 hrs a day on weekdays. Change it to your own number; it applies to whoever you're acting as.

Love Tap

Send a token just because — no favor required. One of your points becomes one of their tokens, right away.

Redeem tokens

Spend your own tokens on something for yourself. The other person gets a notice to add it to the log — no approval needed.

Buy more points

Trade your tokens back into spendable points, 1 token = 1 point.

Spend points on a favor

Set the price, lock it in, then hold phones together — the other phone gets the offer to accept, decline, or counter.

Value estimator Default guess

Points = time the favor takes ÷ your weekly downtime × 100. At the default 10 hrs/week, 1 hour = 10 pts. Anything under 1 pt rounds up to 1 — nothing is free.

Type a favor above — common asks get an average time automatically, like searching “how long does it take to…”. Or just enter the time yourself.

Drag a column slowly for one digit at a time — flick it faster to spin through more numbers, and let go to let it coast. Tap a column, then type, if you'd rather.

Bounties

Tasks & chores worth real compensation. Bounties pay tokens directly — no points, no expiry. Visible to everyone. A bounty has to be approved at an agreed value & due date before anyone can grab it.

Post a bounty

Anyone can post one. The other person approves it — and agrees the value & completion date — before it goes live.

Value estimator Default guess

Not sure what this bounty is worth? Same math: time ÷ your weekly downtime × 100. Bounties pay tokens, and 1 pt = 1 token, so the suggested points become the suggested tokens.

Name the task above — common chores get an average time automatically. Or enter the time yourself.

The hunter ticks these off as they go. All must be checked before they can Claim. Leave blank if there are none.

Transaction log

Every transfer, redemption, and allowance lands here. Tap “Add details” on any entry to note what it was really for.
